spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.summary: Hurl a mote of fire: ranged spell attack, 1d10 fire.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.summary: A freezing beam: ranged spell attack, 1d8 cold, and the target's speed drops by 10 ft until your next turn.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.summary: Melee spell attack, 1d8 lightning, with advantage against metal armor; the target can't take reactions until its next turn.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.summary: One target, or two within 5 ft of each other: Dex save or 1d6 acid.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.summary: Ranged spell attack, 1d8 necrotic; the target can't regain HP until your next turn (undead also get disadvantage attacking you).

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.summary: A beam of crackling force: ranged spell attack, 1d10 force. Two beams at level 5.

upcast.note: Cantrip: 2 beams at character level 5 (not extra dice).

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.summary: Con save or 1d12 poison.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.summary: Radiant flame: Dex save (no cover bonus) or 1d8 radiant.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.summary: A magical insult: Wis save or 1d4 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack roll.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.summary: A flame in your hand gives light; throw it (30 ft) as a ranged spell attack for 1d8 fire.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.summary: Your club or quarterstaff uses Wisdom for attack and damage, deals a d8, and counts as magical.

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.summary: Melee spell attack, 1d6 piercing, and pull a Large or smaller target 10 ft closer.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.summary: The target adds 1d4 to one ability check of its choice.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.summary: A dying creature becomes stable.

spells.name: Light
spells.summary: An object glows like a torch for an hour.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.summary: A spectral hand moves or manipulates light objects up to 30 ft away.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.summary: Create a small sound or image; Investigation reveals it.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.summary: Small magical tricks: clean, warm, flavor, light a candle.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.summary: Minor wonders: a booming voice, flickering flames, tremors.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.summary: Up to four floating lights you can move around.

spells.name: Bless
spells.summary: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spells.name: Bane
spells.summary: Up to three creatures make a Cha save or subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saves.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.summary: A 15-ft cone of flame: Dex save, 3d6 fire, half on a success.

spells.name: Color Spray
spells.summary: Roll 6d10: creatures in a 15-ft cone are blinded until the end of your next turn, lowest current HP first, while the total lasts. Unconscious and blind creatures are skipped.

upcast.note: Higher-level bonus believed +2d10 per level (Rules_Scope CONFIRM LOCALLY).

spells.name: Command
spells.summary: A one-word command (Flee, Drop, Grovel, Halt): Wis save or obey on its next turn.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.summary: Touch: heal 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier. No effect on undead or constructs.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.summary: Bonus action at range: heal 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.summary: Ranged spell attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target before your next turn ends has advantage.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.summary: Melee spell attack, 3d10 necrotic.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.summary: Three darts that always hit, 1d4 + 1 force each; split them between targets as you like. They strike together.

upcast.note: One more dart per slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Shield
spells.summary: Reaction when hit or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until your next turn, including against the triggering attack; Magic Missile does nothing.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.summary: An unarmored creature's base AC becomes 13 + Dex modifier for 8 hours.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.summary: Roll 5d8: creatures within 20 ft of a point fall unconscious, lowest current HP first, while the total lasts. Undead and charm-immune creatures are unaffected.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.summary: A 15-ft cube of thunder: Con save, 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 ft; half damage and no push on a success.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.summary: A 20-ft cube: Dex save or outlined in light. Attacks against outlined creatures have advantage, and they can't be invisible.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.summary: Grasping weeds fill a 20-ft square (difficult terrain): Str save or restrained.

spells.name: Hex
spells.summary: Curse a creature: +1d6 necrotic whenever you hit it, and disadvantage on checks with one ability you choose. Move the curse if it drops to 0 HP.

effects.note: 1d6 necrotic per hit vs the target

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.summary: Mark a creature: +1d6 damage whenever you hit it with a weapon, and advantage on tracking it.

effects.note: 1d6 per weapon hit vs the target

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.summary: Reaction when damaged: the attacker makes a Dex save, 2d10 fire, half on a success.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.summary: 5 temporary HP; while they last, creatures that hit you in melee take 5 cold damage.

upcast.note: +5 temporary HP and +5 cold per slot level.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.summary: +2 AC to one creature.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.summary: Your weapon hits deal an extra 1d4 radiant.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.summary: Enemies who target the warded creature must pass a Wis save or pick another target. Ends if the ward attacks or casts at an enemy.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.summary: A humanoid makes a Wis save (advantage if you're fighting it) or is charmed by you for an hour.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.summary: Wis save: 3d6 psychic and it must use its reaction to move away from you; half damage only on a success.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.summary: Sense magic within 30 ft and see its aura.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.summary: Reaction: up to five falling creatures drift down safely.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.summary: A 20-ft sphere of heavy fog blocks vision.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.summary: Change how you look for an hour.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.summary: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage attacking the target, and can't charm, frighten or possess it.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.summary: Ten berries; each heals 1 HP and feeds a creature for a day.

spells.name: Aid
spells.summary: Up to three creatures gain +5 current and maximum HP for 8 hours.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.summary: A humanoid makes a Wis save or is paralyzed: attacks against it have advantage, and any hit from within 5 ft is a critical hit. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.summary: Teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.summary: Three rays, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire; aim them at one or several targets.

upcast.note: One more ray per slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.summary: A 10-ft-radius burst of sound: Con save, 3d8 thunder, half on a success.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.summary: A floating weapon appears; as a bonus action each turn it moves 20 ft and makes a melee spell attack for 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier force.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.summary: A 5-ft-radius, 40-ft-high cylinder of moonlight: creatures entering or starting there make a Con save, 2d10 radiant, half on a success. Move it 60 ft as an action.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.summary: A 5-ft ball of fire: creatures ending their turn next to it make a Dex save, 2d6 fire, half on a success. Roll it 30 ft as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.summary: A 20-ft-radius area of hidden thorns: difficult terrain, and 2d4 piercing per 5 ft moved through it.

spells.name: Web
spells.summary: A 20-ft cube of sticky webs: Dex save or restrained (Str check to break free). Difficult terrain.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.summary: End one disease, or one of these conditions: blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.summary: Out of combat: up to six creatures heal 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.summary: A creature turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.summary: Three illusory duplicates; attacks may hit a duplicate instead (AC 10 + Dex; destroyed when hit).

spells.name: Silence
spells.summary: A 20-ft-radius sphere of silence: no sound, no verbal spells, creatures inside are deafened and immune to thunder damage.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.summary: A metal object glows red-hot: 2d8 fire to whoever holds or wears it, again as a bonus action each turn.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.summary: You and allies within 30 ft get +10 to Stealth checks.

spells.name: Branding Smite
spells.summary: Your next weapon hit deals +2d6 radiant and makes the target visible.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.summary: Suggest a reasonable course of action: Wis save or the target follows it. Also used in dialogue.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.summary: A 15-ft-radius sphere of magical darkness that ordinary darkvision can't see through.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.summary: A 20-ft-radius explosion of fire: Dex save, 8d6 fire, half on a success.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.summary: A 100-ft line, 5 ft wide: Dex save, 8d6 lightning, half on a success.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.summary: Reaction: stop a spell of 3rd level or lower. A higher-level spell needs an ability check, DC 10 + its level.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.summary: End spells of 3rd level or lower on a target; higher ones need an ability check, DC 10 + their level.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.summary: Spirits circle you to 15 ft: enemies there move at half speed, and entering or starting a turn there means a Wis save, 3d8 radiant, half on a success.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.summary: Bring back a creature that died within the last minute, with 1 HP. Uses up a 300 gp diamond.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.summary: Bonus action: up to six creatures heal 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.summary: A 30-ft cube of shifting colors: Wis save or charmed and incapacitated (speed 0) until it takes damage or is shaken awake.

spells.name: Haste
spells.summary: A willing creature gets double speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dex saves and one extra limited action each turn. When it ends, the target loses its next turn.

spells.name: Fly
spells.summary: A creature gains a flying speed of 60 ft.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.summary: A storm cloud overhead: each turn, call a bolt onto a 5-ft-radius spot, Dex save, 3d10 lightning, half on a success.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.summary: Summon friendly beasts. v1: two wolves only, to keep it simple [inferred simplification from Rules_Scope §5].

spells.name: Hunger of Hadar
spells.summary: A 20-ft-radius sphere of freezing darkness: creatures starting a turn inside take 2d6 cold; ending a turn inside, a Dex save or 2d6 acid.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.summary: Melee spell attack, 3d6 necrotic, and you heal half the damage. Repeat as an action each turn.

spells.name: Fear
spells.summary: A 30-ft cone of terror: Wis save or drop what it holds, become frightened and run away; repeat the save when out of sight of you.

spells.name: Slow
spells.summary: Up to six creatures in a 40-ft cube: Wis save or half speed, −2 AC and Dex saves, no reactions, and only an action or a bonus action. Repeat the save each turn.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.summary: End all curses on a creature or object.

spells.name: Beacon of Hope
spells.summary: Allies get advantage on Wis saves and death saves, and regain the maximum from healing.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.summary: A 20-ft-radius nauseating cloud: Con save or waste its action retching.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.summary: A 40-ft-radius storm of sleet: difficult terrain, Dex save or fall prone, concentration checks.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.summary: Step into a stone wall or floor and hide there.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.summary: A creature can climb walls and ceilings, hands free.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.summary: A creature is invisible for 1 minute, even while attacking or casting.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.summary: A 20-ft-radius, 40-ft-high cylinder of hail: Dex save, 2d8 bludgeoning + 4d6 cold, half on a success. Difficult terrain until your next turn.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.summary: A 60-ft cone of cold: Con save, 8d8 cold, half on a success.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.summary: Touch a willing creature: it adds 1d4 to its saving throws for the next minute (concentration).

spells.name: False Life
spells.summary: Borrow a little death: gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for an hour.

upcast.note: +5 temporary HP per slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.summary: A sickly green ray: ranged spell attack, 2d8 poison, and a Con save or the target is poisoned until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
spells.summary: A creature finds everything hilarious: Wis save or it falls prone and can do nothing but laugh. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.summary: Your next weapon hit flares with white-hot flame: +1d6 fire. (The PHB also sets the target burning; this game applies only the hit.)

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.summary: Con save or the target is blinded for a minute (attacks against it have advantage; its own have disadvantage). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Blur
spells.summary: Your body shimmers and blurs: attacks against you have disadvantage for a minute (concentration).

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce
spells.summary: Make an ally grow to twice their size: their weapon hits deal +1d4 damage for a minute. (This game uses the Enlarge half only.)

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.summary: A weapon becomes magical: its wielder gets +1 to attack and damage rolls for an hour.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.summary: A line of strong wind, 60 ft long: each creature in it makes a Str save or is pushed 15 ft away. (This game uses the first blast only.)
spells.verifyNote: Added Nov 21 (owner asked for more spells), from memory of the PHB: check dice, saves, range and duration.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.summary: Touch a creature: it resists fire for an hour (concentration). (The PHB lets you pick acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder; this game always uses fire, the mountain's danger.)

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.summary: Touch a creature: Wis save or it's cursed, and your attacks and spells against it deal +1d8 necrotic. (This game uses that one of the curse's options.)

spells.name: Daylight
spells.summary: A 60-ft sphere of bright light for an hour that dispels magical darkness. (Used in scenes and exploring.)
